game_concept: A puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart, the glowing heart of the ruins: the rune scholar must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Queue Line: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart: the glowing heart of the ruins
core_gameplay_loop: In Eldritch Heart, repeat each round: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the queue_calm value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the crypt seal using at most 23 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The crypt seal reached with actions_used <= 23.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 23 before the crypt seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Queue Line
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Queue Line' (Week 7 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Eldritch Heart'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how queue_calm changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Eldritch Heart.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The crypt seal reached with actions_used <= 23.
